title: What the Luna Moth means

is_this_you.pressure: You weigh both pans until the candle burns low. Then the dark gets lonely, and you fly at the nearest light.
is_this_you.love: You catch one person's scent across a sleeping city, then ask a friend whether you imagined it.
is_this_you.cost: You give the whole of yourself in one short season. Coarse hands bruise you for longer than the season lasted.

opener.text: In the Book of Songs, a poet praising a great beauty gave her a cicada's forehead and a moth's eyebrows, 螓首蛾眉 (qín shǒu é méi) [S11]. The moth's feathered antennae were the loveliest brow the poet knew [S11]. In Chinese, the moth begins as beauty. You were born under that brow, a Libra ruled by Venus [S5] in the gentle Goat year [S7].

howto: Three parts, best read after dark.

tabs.label: How you shine
tabs.intro: Venus Air above, soft Earth below.

rows.text: Libra is cardinal Air, the sign of the scales [S5]. The Goat is yin Earth, gentle and artistic, and slow to change [S7] [S8]. In you the scales hang over a soft heart. Once the weighing is done, you settle and give.

rows.k: The luna moth does it too
rows.text: A male luna moth can follow a female's scent from several miles away [S1]. As an adult it cannot feed, and it lives about a week [S1]. It has nothing to waste on the wrong signal. Neither does your taste, the brightest thing about you.

tabs.label: The flame
tabs.intro: The old warning, and the luck inside it.

rows.text: Libra's old weakness is indecision [S5]. The Goat clings once it lands [S7]. So you hover at the edge of a choice for weeks. Then the waiting gets lonely and you dive at whatever glows closest.

Your fights happen at night. By day you smooth things over, and the argument grows in the dark. The scales still want a fair hearing [S5]. One calm talk, both sides weighed, puts the flame back in its lamp.

tabs.label: Who you choose by moonlight
tabs.intro: Three lamps worth flying to, one to pass by.
tabs.love_lead: In love you fall through atmosphere: a voice, a scent, a table set with care. The nearest light is always there, and it is rarely the one. Three old pairings favor you.

easy.why: The Swift (Gemini, Horse year) is your secret friend, since the Horse and the Goat combine, and Gemini shares your Air [S8] [S5].
The Axolotl (Aquarius, Rabbit year) sits in your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, with Aquarius as the third Air sign [S8] [S5].
The Platypus (Aquarius, Pig year) brings the Pig that closes your trine, and more Air for yours [S8] [S5].

hard.why: The hard one is the Shoebill (Capricorn, Ox year): the Ox clashes with the Goat, and the Goat's closed private life is said to frustrate the Ox [S8] [S9].

story.text: Chinese keeps a four-character warning for the moth that throws itself into the fire, 飞蛾扑火 (fēi é pū huǒ). It means rushing toward your own ruin, and the novel Water Margin uses it [S12].

closing: The pull that could take you into the flame is the same one that finds the right lamp across miles of dark.
